metrics-surfaces.title: Choose a metrics surface
metrics-surfaces.description: Compare the usage, code generation and impact dashboards with the report endpoints and NDJSON exports by window and best use.

metrics-access.title: Who can read Copilot metrics
metrics-access.description: Check the usage metrics policy, then the enterprise or organization role or permission, and run automated downloads under a dedicated identity with the right token scope.

active-user-definitions.title: Active user counting windows
active-user-definitions.description: Daily, weekly and monthly active users count distinct users over the report day, the trailing 7 days and the trailing 28 days, while the dashboard total covers the calendar month to date.

adoption-phases.title: Assign an adoption phase
adoption-phases.description: Find features engaged on at least two distinct days in a trailing 28-day window, then assign the highest qualifying phase: multi-agent, agent first, code first or No Cohort.

org-attribution-dedup.title: One person across report scopes
org-attribution-dedup.description: A hypothetical developer with one seat who belongs to two organizations appears in both organization reports but only once in the enterprise report.

team-level-joins.title: Build a team view
team-level-joins.description: Join the daily per-user and user-teams reports on user, day and entity, group by team, count distinct users and sum volume, then publish with the five-user and multi-team caveats.

latency-and-windows.title: When daily data is final
latency-and-windows.description: A report day closes, two full UTC days of processing follow, early exports are provisional and should be re-exported, history is limited to one year and download links expire.

coverage-gaps.title: Layers between activity and reports
coverage-gaps.description: Developer activity reaches usage reports only through a supported client, enabled telemetry and an open network path; server-side telemetry still identifies some active users.

kpi-design.title: A small adoption KPI sheet
kpi-design.description: Four group-level adoption KPIs, each with the decision it informs, a numerator and a denominator measured over the same window and scope.

privacy-safe-reporting.title: Who sees which metrics
privacy-safe-reporting.description: A reporting charter limits per-user files to named analysts, gives team leads views of five or more people and gives leaders headline KPIs, with no individual performance use.

qualitative-evidence.title: Metrics raise questions, people answer
qualitative-evidence.description: Spot a metric change, ask developers through surveys, retrospectives or support trends, record respondent counts and dates, then explain and act before the next cycle.

impact-reporting.title: Impact report lifecycle
impact-reporting.description: Define the decision, fix the comparison, assemble evidence, separate observations from conclusions, then write the narrative with a next review date that restarts the cycle.
